G3700.b:
† ⟪ὀπτάνω⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦1 Kings 8:8|III Ki 8:8⟧ (⁨ראה⁩ ni.), To 12:19*;] late present as from ὤφθην (= ὁράω); mid., ὀπτάνομαι, ⟪to allow oneself to be seen⟫, ⟪to appear⟫. c. dat., ⟦Acts 1:3|Ac 1:3⟧. (For exx. from π., v. Deiss., LAE, 79, 2525; MM, ii, xviii.).†
a: Light from the Ancient East, by A. Deissmann, tr. by L. R. M. Strachan. Second Edition. Hodder, 1908

G3701.b:
† ⟪ὀπτασία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< ὀπτάζομαι, ⟦Numbers 14:14|Nu 14:14⟧* = ὀπτάνομαι), later form of ὄψις, [in LXX: ⟦Malachi 3:2|Ma 3:2⟧ (⁨ראה⁩ ni.), ⟦Daniel 9:23|Da TH 9:23⟧ ⟦Daniel 10:1|10:1⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:7|7⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:8|8⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:16|16⟧ (⁨מַרְאֶה⁩, ⁨מַרְאָה⁩; LXX, ὅραμα, -σις), ⟦Ezra 4:7|Es 4:7⟧, Si 43:2, 16*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪an appearing⟫, ⟪coming into view⟫ (⟦Malachi 3:2|Ma 3:2⟧, ⟦Ezra 4:7|Es 4:7⟧, Si 43:2, 16).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a vision⟫: ⟦Luke 1:22|Lk 1:22⟧ ⟦Luke 24:23|24:23⟧, ⟦Acts 26:19|Ac 26:19⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 12:1|II Co 12:1⟧ (⟦Daniel 9:23|Da 9:23⟧ ⟦Daniel 10:1|10:1⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:7|7⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:8|8⟧, ⟦Daniel 10:16|16⟧, also in MGr.).†

G3703.b:
⟪ὀπώρα⟫, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX: ⟦Jeremiah 48:32|Je 31 (48):32⟧ ⟦Jeremiah 40:10|47 (40):10⟧, ⟦Jeremiah 40:12|12⟧ (⁨קַיִץ⁩)*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪late summer⟫, ⟪early autumn⟫ (the time between the risings of Sirius and Arcturus, i.e. late July, all August and early September).
⟪2.⟫ By meton. (as being fruit-time), ⟪ripe fruits⟫ ⟦Revelation 18:14|Re 18:14⟧ (cf. φθινοπωρινά, ⟦Jude 1:12|Ju 12⟧).†

G3704.b:
⟪ὅπως⟫.
⟪I.⟫ Relat. adv. of manner, ⟪as⟫, ⟪how⟫: c. indic., ⟦Luke 24:20|Lk 24:20⟧.
⟪II.⟫ Conj., c. subjc. (in cl. also c. opt., indic.: so in ⟦Matthew 26:59|Mt 26:59⟧, LT, Tr.),⟪in order that⟫,⟪to the end that⟫, ⟪that⟫;
	⟪1.⟫ final, denoting purpose or design (in which the original idea of modality has been merged): after pres., ⟦Matthew 6:2|Mt 6:2⟧, al.; pf., ⟦Acts 9:17|Ac 9:17⟧, al.; impf., ⟦Acts 9:24|Ac 9:24⟧; aor., ⟦Acts 9:2|Ac 9:2⟧, al.; plpf., ⟦John 11:57|Jo 11:57⟧; fut., ⟦Matthew 23:35|Mt 23:35⟧; imperat., ⟦Matthew 2:8|Mt 2:8⟧, al.; ὅ. μή (M, Pr., 185), ⟦Matthew 6:18|Mt 6:18⟧, ⟦Luke 16:26|Lk 16:26⟧, ⟦Acts 20:16|Ac 20:16⟧, ⟦1 Corinthians 1:29|I Co 1:29⟧; ὅ. πληρωθῇ, ⟦Matthew 2:23|Mt 2:23⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:17|8:17⟧ ⟦Matthew 13:35|13:35⟧; ὅ. ἄν (Bl., § 65, 2; WM, § 42, 5), ⟦Luke 2:35|Lk 2:35⟧, ⟦Acts 3:19|Ac 3:19⟧ ⟦Acts 15:17|15:17⟧, ⟦Romans 3:4|Ro 3:4⟧ (cf. ⟦Genesis 12:13|Ge 12:13⟧, ⟦Psalms 59:7|Ps 59:7⟧, I Mac 10:32, al.).
	⟪2.⟫ After verbs of asking, exhorting, etc.: ⟦Matthew 9:38|Mt 9:38⟧, ⟦Luke 7:3|Lk 7:3⟧, ⟦James 5:16|Ja 5:16⟧, al. (in late writers its place is often taken by the correl. πῶς, q.v.).
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908
A Grammar of N.T. Greek, tr. from G. B. Winer's 7th Edition, with large additions, by W. P. Moulton. Third Edition. T. & T. Clark, 1882

G3706.b:
⟪ὅρασις⟫, -εως, ἡ
(ὁράω), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨מַרְאֶה⁩, ⁨חָזוֹן⁩ and cognate forms;]
⟪1.⟫ in Arist. and later writers, ⟪the act of seeing⟫, ⟪the sense of sight⟫, and by meton., pl., ⟪the eyes⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪appearance⟫ (⟦Numbers 24:4|Nu 24:4⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 1:5|Ez 1:5⟧, Si 41:20, al.): ⟦Revelation 4:3|Re 4:3⟧.
⟪3.⟫ = ὅραμα, ⟪a vision⟫: ⟦Acts 2:17|Ac 2:17⟧(LXX), ⟦Revelation 9:17|Re 9:17⟧.†

G3708.b:
⟪ὁράω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨ראה⁩, also for ⁨חזה⁩, etc.;] in "durative" sense (hence aor. act., εἶδον, pass., ὤφθην, fut., ὄψομαι, from different roots; v. M, Pr., 110 f.), ⟪to see⟫ (in colloq. even the pres. is rare, its place being generally taken by βλέτω, θεωρέω, v. Bl., § 24).
⟪1.⟫ Of bodily vision, ⟪to see⟫, ⟪perceive⟫, ⟪behold⟫: absol., ⟦Mark 6:38|Mk 6:38⟧, al.; ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε, ⟦John 1:46|Jo 1:46⟧, al.; seq. ὅτι, ⟦Mark 2:16|Mk 2:16⟧, al.; c. acc., ⟦Matthew 2:2|Mt 2:2⟧, ⟦Mark 1:10|Mk 1:10⟧ ⟦Mark 16:7|16:7⟧, ⟦Galatians 1:19|Ga 1:19⟧, al.; θεόν, ⟦John 1:18|Jo 1:18⟧, ⟦1 John 4:20|I Jo 4:20⟧, al.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to see⟫ with the mind, ⟪perceive⟫, ⟪discern⟫: absol, ⟦Romans 15:21|Ro 15:21⟧; c. acc. rei., ⟦Matthew 9:2|Mt 9:2⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:54|27:54⟧, ⟦Acts 8:23|Ac 8:23⟧, ⟦Colossians 2:18|Col 2:18⟧, al.
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to see⟫, ⟪take heed⟫, ⟪beware⟫: ὅρα μή, c. aor. subjc., ⟦Matthew 8:4|Mt 8:4⟧ ⟦Matthew 18:10|18:10⟧, ⟦Mark 1:44|Mk 1:44⟧, ⟦1 Thessalonians 5:15|I Th 5:15⟧; id., sc. μὴ ποήσῃς, ⟦Revelation 19:10|Re 19:10⟧ ⟦Revelation 22:9|22:9⟧ (Bl., § 81, 1); seq. imperat. ⟦Matthew 9:30|Mt 9:30⟧ ⟦Matthew 16:6|16:6⟧, ⟦Mark 8:15|Mk 8:15⟧.
⟪4.⟫ ⟪to experience⟫: τ. θάνατον, ⟦Luke 2:26|Lk 2:26⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:5|He 11:5⟧; ζωήν, ⟦John 3:36|Jo 3:36⟧; τ. διαφθοράν, ⟦Acts 2:27|Ac 2:27⟧.
⟪5.⟫ ⟪to visit⟫: c. acc. pers., ⟦Luke 8:20|Lk 8:20⟧, ⟦John 12:21|Jo 12:21⟧, ⟦Romans 1:11|Ro 1:11⟧, al.; c. acc. loc., ⟦Acts 19:21|Ac 19:21⟧.
⟪6.⟫ ⟪to see to⟫, ⟪care for⟫: ⟦Matthew 27:4|Mt 27:4⟧, ⟦Acts 18:15|Ac 18:15⟧ (cf. ἀφ-, καθ-, προ-, συν-οράω).
SYN.: v.s. βλέπω.
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G3710.b:
⟪ὀργίζω⟫
(< ὀργή), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨חרה⁩, also for ⁨קצף⁩, etc.;] ⟪to make angry⟫, ⟪provoke to anger⟫; in cl. most freq. in pass., and so always in NT, ⟪to be provoked to anger⟫, ⟪be angry⟫: absol., ⟦Matthew 18:34|Mt 18:34⟧ ⟦Matthew 22:7|22:7⟧, ⟦Luke 14:21|Lk 14:21⟧ ⟦Luke 15:28|15:28⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:26|Eph 4:26⟧(LXX), ⟦Revelation 11:18|Re 11:18⟧; c. dat., ⟦Matthew 5:22|Mt 5:22⟧; seq. ἐπί, c. dat. (⟦1 Kings 11:9|III Ki 11:9⟧, al.), ⟦Revelation 12:17|Re 12:17⟧ (cf. παρ-ὀργίζω).†

G3712.b:
* ⟪ὀργυιά⟫, -ᾶς, ἡ
(< ὀρέγω), the length of the outstretched arms, ⟪a fathom⟫: ⟦Acts 27:28|Ac 27:28⟧.†

G3713.b:
** ⟪ὀρέγω⟫,
[in Sm.: ⟦Job 8:20|Jb 8:20⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 16:49|Ez 16:49⟧*;] ⟪to reach⟫, ⟪stretch out⟫; pass. and mid., ⟪to stretch oneself out⟫, ⟪reach forth⟫; metaph., ⟪to reach after⟫, ⟪grasp at⟫, ⟪aspire to⟫: c. gen. rei, ⟦1 Timothy 3:1|I Ti 3:1⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:16|He 11:16⟧; φιλαργυρίας (v. Ellic. and CGT, in l.), ⟦1 Timothy 6:10|I Ti 6:10⟧.†
SYN.: ἐπιθυμέω, to desire (q.v.).
a: Cambridge Greek Testament for Schools and Colleges
Commentary on St. Paul's Epistles, by C. J. Ellicott. Andover, 1860-65

G3714.b:
⟪ὀρεινός⟫ (WH, ὀριν-; v. MM, xviii,) -ή, -όν
(< ὄρος), ⟪mountainous⟫, ⟪hilly⟫; ἡ ὀ. (sc. χώρα), ⟪the hill-country⟫ (LXX for ⁨הַר⁩): ⟦Luke 1:39|Lk 1:39⟧, ⟦Luke 1:65|65⟧.†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3715.b:
** ⟪ὄρεξις⟫, -εως, ἡ
(< ὀρέγομαι), [in LXX Wi 14:2 15:5 16:2, 3, Si 18:30 23:6, IV Mac 1:33, 35*;] the most general ward for all kinds of ⟪desire⟫, ⟪longing⟫, ⟪appetite⟫: of lust, ⟦Romans 1:27|Ro 1:27⟧.
SYN.: v.s. πάθος.

G3716.b:
*† ⟪ὀρθοποδέω⟫, -ῶ
(< ὀρθό-πους, going straight), = cl. εὐθυπορέω, ⟪to walk straight⟫: metaph., ⟦Galatians 2:14|Ga 2:14⟧ (not elsewhere).†

G3718.b:
† ⟪ὀρθοτομέω⟫, -ῶ
(< ὀρθός, τέμνω), [in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 3:6|Pr 3:6⟧ ⟦Proverbs 11:6|11:6⟧ (⁨ישׁר⁩ pi.)*;] ⟪to cut straight⟫, as a road (τ. ὁδούς, fig., ⟦Proverbs 3:6|Pr 3:6⟧ ⟦Proverbs 11:6|11:6⟧). Metaph., τ. λόγον τ. ἀληθείας, ⟦2 Timothy 2:15|II Ti 2:15⟧ (V. Ellic. and CGT, in l.; not found elsewhere).†
a: Cambridge Greek Testament for Schools and Colleges
Commentary on St. Paul's Epistles, by C. J. Ellicott. Andover, 1860-65

G3719.b:
† ⟪ὀρθρίζω⟫
(< ὄρθρος), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨שׁכם⁩ hi., ⟦Genesis 19:2|Ge 19:2⟧, al.; also for ⁨שׁחר⁩ pi., ⟦Psalms 63:1|Ps 62:1 (63)⟧, al., etc.;] = cl. poët., ὀρθρεύω, ⟪to rise early⟫: seq. πρός, c. acc. pers. (as ⟦Psalms 63:1|Ps 62:1 (63)⟧, al.), ⟦Luke 21:38|Lk 21:38⟧ (v. Thumb, Hellen., 123).†
a: Die Griechische Sprache im Zeitalter des Hellenismus, von A. Thumb. Strassburg, 1901

G3720.b:
† ⟪ὀρθρινός⟫, -ή, -όν
(< ὄρθρος), [in LXX: ⟦Hosea 6:5|Ho 6:⟧ (⟦Hosea 6:4|4⟧) ⟦Hosea 13:3|13:3⟧ (⁨שׁכם⁩ hi.), ⟦Haggai 2:15|Hg 2:15⟧ (⟦Haggai 2:14|14⟧), Wi 11:22*;] late form of ὄρθριος (q.v.), ⟪early⟫: ⟦Luke 24:22|Lk 24:22⟧.†

G3721.b:
⟪ὄρθριος⟫, -α, -ον
(< ὄρθρος), [in LXX: ⟦1 Samuel 28:14|I Ki 28:14⟧, ⟦Job 29:7|Jb 29:7⟧, III Mac 5:10, 23*;] ⟪early⟫, ⟪in the early morning⟫: ⟦Luke 24:22|Lk 24:22⟧, Rec. (v.s. ὀρθρινός).†

G3722.b:
⟪ὄρθρος⟫, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for ⁨שַׁחַר⁩, ⁨בֹּקֶר⁩, etc.;] ⟪daybreak⟫, ⟪dawn⟫: ὄρθρου βαθέως (M, Pr., 73), ⟪at early dawn⟫, ⟦Luke 24:1|Lk 24:1⟧; ὄρθρου, ⟦John 8:2|Jo 8:[2]⟧; ὑπὸ τὸν ὄ., ⟦Acts 5:21|Ac 5:21⟧ (cf. MM, xviii).†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G3724.b:
⟪ὁρίζω⟫
(< ὅρος, a boundary), [in LXX for ⁨אסר⁩, ⁨גּבל⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to separate⟫, ⟪mark off by boundaries⟫ (so ⟦Numbers 34:6|Nu 34:6⟧, ⟦John 13:27|Jo 13:27⟧).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to determine⟫, ⟪appoint⟫, ⟪designate⟫: of time, c. acc., ⟦Acts 17:26|Ac 17:26⟧, ⟦Hebrews 4:7|He 4:7⟧; c. acc. pers., ⟦Acts 17:31|Ac 17:31⟧; c. inf., ⟦Acts 11:29|Ac 11:29⟧; pass., ⟦Luke 22:22|Lk 22:22⟧, ⟦Acts 2:23|Ac 2:23⟧ ⟦Acts 10:42|10:42⟧, ⟦Romans 1:4|Ro 1:4⟧ (cf. ἀφ-, ἀπο- δι-, τρο-ορίζω).†

G3725.b:
⟪ὅριον⟫, -ου, τό
(< ὅρος, a boundary), [in LXX chiefly for ⁨גְּבוּל⁩;] ⟪a boundary⟫, ⟪bound⟫; chiefly in pl., and so always in NT: ⟦Matthew 2:16|Mt 2:16⟧ ⟦Matthew 4:13|4:13⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:34|8:34⟧ ⟦Matthew 15:22|15:22⟧, ⟦Matthew 15:39|39⟧ ⟦Matthew 19:1|19:1⟧, ⟦Mark 5:17|Mk 5:17⟧ ⟦Mark 7:24|7:24⟧, ⟦Mark 7:31|31⟧ ⟦Mark 10:1|10:1⟧, ⟦Acts 13:50|Ac 13:50⟧.†

G3726.b:
⟪ὁρκίζω⟫
(< ὅρκος), [in LXX: ⟦Genesis 24:37|Ge 24:37⟧, al. (⁨שׁבע⁩ hi.);]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to make⟫ one ⟪swear⟫ (Xen., Polyb., a1.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to adjure⟫: c. dupl. acc., ⟦Mark 5:7|Mk 5:7⟧, ⟦Acts 19:13|Ac 19:13⟧ (cf. ἐν-, ἐξ-ορκίζω).†

G3727.b:
⟪ὅρκος⟫, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨שֶׁבַע⁩, ⁨שִׁבְעָה⁩ and cogn. forms;] ⟪an oath⟫: ⟦Matthew 14:7|Mt 14:7⟧ ⟦Matthew 26:72|26:72⟧, ⟦Luke 1:73|Lk 1:73⟧, ⟦Acts 2:30|Ac 2:30⟧, ⟦Hebrews 6:16|He 6:16⟧, ⟦Hebrews 6:17|17⟧, ⟦James 5:12|Ja 5:12⟧; p1., ⟦Matthew 5:33|Mt 5:33⟧(LXX) ⟦Matthew 14:9|14:9⟧, ⟦Mark 6:26|Mk 6:26⟧.†

G3728.b:
⟪ὁρκωμοσία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< ὅρκος, ὄμνυμι; by metapl. for τὰ ὁρκωμόσια, asseverations on oath; v. MM, xviii), [in LXX: ⟦Ezekiel 17:18|Ez 17:18⟧, ⟦Ezekiel 17:19|19⟧ (⁨אָלָה⁩) I Es 9:93*;] ⟪affirmation on oath⟫, ⟪an oath⟫: ⟦Hebrews 7:20|He 7:20⟧, ⟦Hebrews 7:21|21⟧, ⟦Hebrews 7:28|28⟧.†

G3729.b:
⟪ὁρμάω⟫, -ῶ
(< ὁρμή), [in LXX for ⁨שׁוּב⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ causal, ⟪to set in motion⟫, ⟪urge on⟫.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans., ⟪to hasten on⟫, ⟪rush⟫: seq. εἰς, ⟦Matthew 8:32|Mt 8:32⟧, ⟦Mark 5:13|Mk 5:13⟧, ⟦Luke 8:33|Lk 8:33⟧, ⟦Acts 19:29|Ac 19:29⟧; ἐπί, c. acc., ⟦Acts 7:57|Ac 7:57⟧.†

G3730.b:
⟪ὁρμή⟫, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX: ⟦Proverbs 3:25|Pr 3:25⟧ (⁨שֹׁאָה⁩), etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪a violent movement⟫, ⟪impulse⟫: ⟦James 3:4|Ja 3:4⟧;
⟪2.⟫ ⟪a hostile movement⟫, ⟪onset⟫, ⟪assault⟫. ⟦Acts 14:5|Ac 14:5⟧.†

G3732.b:
⟪ὄρνεον⟫, -ου, τό, = ὄρνις,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨צִפּוֹר⁩;] ⟪a bird⟫: ⟦Revelation 18:2|Re 18:2⟧ ⟦Revelation 19:17|19:17⟧, ⟦Revelation 19:21|21⟧ (Hom., al.).†

G3733.b:
⟪ὄρνις⟫, -ιθος, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX: ὄ. ἐκλεκταί, ⟦1 Kings 3:1|III Ki 3:1⟧ ⟦1 Kings 4:23|4:23⟧ (⟦1 Kings 5:3|5:3⟧) (⁨בַּרְבֻּרִים⁩)*;] ⟪a bird⟫; specif., ⟪a cock⟫, ⟪a hen⟫: ⟦Matthew 23:3|Mt 23:3⟧, ⟦Luke 13:34|Lk 13:34⟧ (WH).†
a: The N.T. in the original Greek, by B. F. Westcott and F. J. A. Hort. Vol. II, Introduction and Appendix. Macmillan, 1881

G3734.b:
*† ⟪ὁροθεσία⟫, -ας, ἡ
(< ὅρος, a boundary, + τίθημι), ⟪a setting of boundaries⟫; in pl., ⟪bounds⟫; ⟦Acts 17:26|Ac 17:26⟧.†

G3735.b:
⟪ὄρος⟫, -ους, τό,
[in LXX chiefly, and very freq., for ⁨הַר⁩;] ⟪a mountain⟫: ⟦Matthew 4:8|Mt 4:8⟧ ⟦Matthew 17:1|17:1⟧, ⟦Mark 9:2|Mk 9:2⟧, ⟦John 4:20|Jo 4:20⟧, ⟦2 Peter 1:18|II Pe 1:18⟧, al.; opp. to βουνός, ⟦Luke 3:5|Lk 3:5⟧(LXX); ὄ. τ. ἐλαιῶν, ⟦Matthew 21:1|Mt 21:1⟧ ⟦Matthew 24:3|24:3⟧, al. (v.s. ἐ.); ὄ. Σιών (Σ., prob. in gem appos.), ⟦Hebrews 12:22|He 12:22⟧, ⟦Revelation 14:1|Re 14:1⟧; ὄ. Σινά, ⟦Acts 7:30|Ac 7:30⟧, ⟦Acts 7:38|38⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:24|Ga 4:24⟧, ⟦Galatians 4:25|25⟧; τὸ ὄ., of the hill district as distinct from the lowlands, esp. the hills above the Sea of Galilee, ⟦Matthew 5:1|Mt 5:1⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:1|8:1⟧, ⟦Mark 3:13|Mk 3:13⟧ ⟦Mark 6:46|6:46⟧, al.; τὰ ὄ., ⟦Matthew 18:12|Mt 18:12⟧, ⟦Mark 5:5|Mk 5:5⟧, ⟦Hebrews 11:38|He 11:38⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:14|Re 6:14⟧, al.; proverbially (cf. Rabbinic, ⁨עקר הרים⁩), of overcoming difficulties, accomplishing marvels, ὄρη μεθιστάνειν, ⟦1 Corinthians 13:2|I Co 13:2⟧, cf. ⟦Matthew 17:20|Mt 17:20⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:21|21:21⟧, ⟦Mark 11:23|Mk 11:23⟧.

G3736.b:
⟪ὀρύσσω⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨חפר⁩, also for ⁨כּרה⁩, etc.;] ⟪to dig⟫: c. acc., ληνόν, ⟦Matthew 21:33|Mt 21:33⟧; ὑπολήνιον, ⟦Mark 12:1|Mk 12:1⟧; γῆν, ⟦Matthew 25:18|Mt 25:18⟧ (cf. δι-, ἐξ-ορύσσω).†

G3737.b:
⟪ὀρφανός⟫, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX for ⁨יָתוֹם⁩;]
⟪1.⟫ prop., ⟪orphan⟫, ⟪fatherless⟫: ⟦Mark 12:40|Mk 12:40⟧, WH, mg, ⟦James 1:27|Ja 1:27⟧.

G3793.b:

[in LXX for ⁨הָמוֹן⁩ (chiefly in Da TH), ⁨חַיִל⁩, ⁨קָהָל⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ a moving ⟪crowd⟫ or ⟪multitude⟫ of persons, ⟪a throng⟫: ⟦Matthew 9:23|Mt 9:23⟧, ⟦Mark 2:4|Mk 2:4⟧, ⟦Luke 5:1|Lk 5:1⟧, ⟦John 5:13|Jo 5:13⟧, al.; pl., ⟦Matthew 5:1|Mt 5:1⟧, ⟦Mark 10:1|Mk 10:1⟧, ⟦Luke 3:7|Lk 3:7⟧, and freq.; ὄ. ἱκανός, ⟦Mark 10:46|Mk 10:46⟧, al.; τοσοῦτος, ⟦Matthew 15:33|Mt 15:33⟧; οὐ μετ’ ὄχλου, ⟦Acts 24:18|Ac 24:18⟧; ἄτερ ὄχλου, ⟦Luke 22:6|Lk 22:6⟧; πᾶς ὁ ὄ., ⟦Matthew 13:2|Mt 13:2⟧, ⟦Mark 2:13|Mk 2:13⟧, al.; ὄ. πολύς (π. ὄ), ⟦Matthew 20:29|Mt 20:29⟧, ⟦Mark 5:21|Mk 5:21⟧, al.; ὁ πολὺς ὄ. (ὄ. π.), ⟪the populace⟫, ⟪the common people⟫, ⟦Mark 12:37|Mk 12:37⟧ (Swete, in l.; Field, Notes, 37), ⟦John 12:9|Jo 12:9⟧ (Westc, in l.).

Tr., Syn., § xcviii), ⟪the populace⟫, ⟪the common people⟫ (cf. ὁ πολὺς ὄ., supr.), ⟦Matthew 14:5|Mt 14:5⟧ ⟦Matthew 21:26|21:26⟧, ⟦Mark 12:12|Mk 12:12⟧, ⟦John 7:12|Jo 7:12b⟧; so with contempt (cl.), ⟦John 7:49|Jo 7:49⟧. In a more general sense, ⟪a multitude⟫: c. gen., ὀνομάτων (v.s. ὀ.), ⟦Acts 1:15|Ac 1:15⟧; μαθητῶν, ⟦Luke 6:17|Lk 6:17⟧, al.

G3796.b:

[in LXX: ⟦Genesis 24:11|Ge 24:11⟧, ⟦Exodus 30:8|Ex 30:8⟧ (⁨עֶרֶב⁩, ⁨הָעַרְבַּיִם⁩ ⁨בֵּין⁩), ⟦Jeremiah 2:23|Je 2:23⟧; τὸ ὀ., ⟦Isaiah 5:11|Is 5:11⟧ (⁨נֶשֶׁף⁩)*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪long after⟫, ⟪late⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪late in the day⟫, ⟪at evening⟫ (opp. to πρωί); in late writers used almost as an indecl. noun (v. MM, xviii): ⟦Mark 11:11|Mk 11:11⟧, ⟦Mark 11:19|19⟧ ⟦Mark 13:35|13:35⟧.
